sections.content: Professional descriptions combine the present tense with expressions that identify a person's role, responsibilities, experience and current activities.

items.spanish: Soy responsable de coordinar un equipo pequeño y tengo cinco años de experiencia.
items.english: I am responsible for coordinating a small team and I have five years of experience.

items.spanish: Trabajo en una empresa tecnológica y me encargo de la formación del personal.
items.english: I work at a technology company and I am in charge of staff training.

items.spanish: Mi puesto consiste en analizar información y preparar informes.
items.english: My position involves analysing information and preparing reports.

items.spanish: Actualmente trabajo con clientes, pero también participo en proyectos internos.
items.english: I currently work with clients, but I also take part in internal projects.

sections.content: Combine who you are, where you work, what your position involves and what you are responsible for.
